newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FAKTO TO ACQUIRE FIAT DEALER.
newsitem.headline: FAKTO TO ACQUIRE FIAT DEALER.

text.p: Estonia's Nissan dealer Fakto will acquire 100 percent of the shares in Asmer Auto, the Fiat dealer in Estonia, the companies said on Thursday.
Fakto will issue 171,675 shares, which will be exchanged for 100 percent of the shares in Asmer, the companies added in a statement. It will raise Fakto's share capital to 16.5 million kroons.
Fakto will also pay Asmer 4.6 million kroons for the shares in eighteen months' time.
The deal, handled by Balti Cresco, will enable the companies to decrease costs and unite expereinces, the firms added.
Fakto predicted that the acquisition would lead to a 1998 turnover of 273 million kroons and profit before taxes of 13.8 million kroons.
Fakto had a turnover of 66.5 million kroons and a profit of 500,000 kroons during the first five months this year.
